name: Animal Friendship
entries: Target a Beast that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for the duration. If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 1.

omissions.mechanic: ending when the caster or an ally damages the target
omissions.reason: Spell-owned damage termination is being added in Wave 1B.
Multi-target spell selection is being added in Wave 1B.
